name: Knowledge Base Tools
description: Provides AI agents with tools to navigate, search, and manage a hierarchical knowledge base of themes, skills, and learning resources with tenant-aware JWT authentication.

rawRecord.description: Provides AI agents with tools to navigate, search, and manage a hierarchical knowledge base of themes, skills, and learning resources with tenant-aware JWT authentication.

MCP_PORT.description: Port number (default: 8100 - port 8000 is used by the Django backend)

BACKEND_URL.description: Fallback backend URL if MCP_BACKEND_URL is not set

MCP_TRANSPORT.description: Transport type - sse (Server-Sent Events) or streamable-http

MCP_BACKEND_URL.description: Backend URL with tenant placeholder, e.g., http://tenant.localhost:8000 (can use BACKEND_URL as fallback)

MCP_JWT_SECRET_KEY.description: Secret key for JWT token verification (can use CHAINLIT_JWT_SECRET_KEY as fallback)

CHAINLIT_JWT_SECRET_KEY.description: Fallback secret key for JWT token verification if MCP_JWT_SECRET_KEY is not set
